generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can pass product checks while required readiness artifacts are absent.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Skip readiness artifact generation after successful product checks.

reusable_control.rule: Validate required readiness artifacts before audit handoff.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Generate and validate required readiness artifacts before audit handoff.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Check certificate identity, artifact hashes, inherited controls and learning closure before broad audit.
